missions.title: Bad at Goodbyes
missions.briefing:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS], we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Data Transfer
missions.briefing:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.

If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?

Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that we want.

All you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Getting To the Bottom of It
missions.briefing:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS]. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Legendary Info?
missions.briefing:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] for us.

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Our Version of The Truth
missions.briefing:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Snatch that blackbox at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

Apparently, this area is a bit of a hot zone. Probably why they staged the accident there. You should probably bring some backup so you don’t get ghosted before you can bring the blackbox to us at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Pick Up, Put Down
missions.briefing:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Too Smart For Our Own Good
missions.briefing:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: A Swift Reprisal
missions.briefing:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: A little retaliation
missions.briefing:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Block XenoThreat Expansion
missions.briefing:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm [LOCATION|ADDRESS] next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it.

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely.

Think you can rise to the occasion?

-Stows
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Death and cargo
missions.briefing:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back.

Once you got the cargo, take it over to [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Driving CFP out
missions.briefing:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole [TARGETNAME] opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.

I need some hard workers to go hit [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and take out [TARGETNAME|LAST]. Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Hit XenoThreat at [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Hit a CFP Complex
missions.briefing:
Got a big one here. We need a team to head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Word is CFP are dug in at three different clusters in the area. Our judge wants them all cleared out. Seems one of their mercs, a real mean skag named [TARGETNAME], is holed up at one of them. We want you to go there, clear them all out and take out [TARGETNAME|LAST].

Get yourself a nice little payday in the process.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Hit on XenoThreat command
missions.briefing:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Hitting a CFP site
missions.briefing:
Need someone to sweep [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge.

Need it done fast and clean.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Need a hitter
missions.briefing:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
missions.briefing:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGETNAME]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Taking XenoThreat Turf
missions.briefing:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts.

We've also gotten word that [TARGETNAME] is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up.

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Taking down a XenoThreat Hideout
missions.briefing:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named [TARGETNAME]. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of [TARGETNAME|LAST] or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and [TARGETNAME|LAST] won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Taking out some XenoThreat trash
missions.briefing:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Turf War
missions.briefing:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: [LOCATION] has been greenlit
missions.briefing:

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.

missions.briefing:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: [LOCATION] has been greenlit
missions.briefing:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: A Swift Reprisal
missions.briefing:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: A little retaliation
missions.briefing:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Block XenoThreat Expansion
missions.briefing:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm [LOCATION|ADDRESS] next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it.

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely.

Think you can rise to the occasion?

-Stows
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Death and cargo
missions.briefing:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back.

Once you got the cargo, take it over to [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Driving CFP out
missions.briefing:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole [TARGETNAME] opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.

I need some hard workers to go hit [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and take out [TARGETNAME|LAST]. Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Hit XenoThreat at [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Hit a CFP Complex
missions.briefing:
Got a big one here. We need a team to head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Word is CFP are dug in at three different clusters in the area. Our judge wants them all cleared out. Seems one of their mercs, a real mean skag named [TARGETNAME], is holed up at one of them. We want you to go there, clear them all out and take out [TARGETNAME|LAST].

Get yourself a nice little payday in the process.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Hit on XenoThreat command
missions.briefing:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Hitting a CFP site
missions.briefing:
Need someone to sweep [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge.

Need it done fast and clean.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Need a hitter
missions.briefing:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
missions.briefing:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGETNAME]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Taking XenoThreat Turf
missions.briefing:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts.

We've also gotten word that [TARGETNAME] is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up.

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Taking down a XenoThreat Hideout
missions.briefing:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named [TARGETNAME]. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of [TARGETNAME|LAST] or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and [TARGETNAME|LAST] won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Taking out some XenoThreat trash
missions.briefing:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows

missions.title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
missions.briefing:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
missions.briefing:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans.

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
missions.briefing:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation.

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
missions.briefing:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system.

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
missions.briefing:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
missions.briefing:
There is a group of outlaws at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system.

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves.

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Take Outlaws at [LOCATION] Offline
missions.briefing:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity.

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion.

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
missions.briefing:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
missions.briefing:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Intercepted Supply Run
missions.briefing:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS]. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Recovering Valuable Supplies
missions.briefing:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.

We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the supplies onto your ship.

Take them to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.

Be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Special Recovery Operation
missions.briefing:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] in order to take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS].

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
missions.briefing:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF:
There's been another attack out at [LOCATION]. Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, retrieve the blackbox and deliver it [DESTINATION]. Make sure you bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet they're still in the area.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Deep space hit
missions.briefing:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TARGETNAME] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TARGETNAME|LAST] around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Green light on [TARGETNAME|LAST]
missions.briefing:
Word's come down through my bosses that we're settling old debts. I've got an open line on this old-time hitter named [TARGETNAME] who's racked up a hefty kill list. We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. [TARGETNAME|LAST] is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out [TARGETNAME|LAST], they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Need a CFP taken down
missions.briefing:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named [TARGETNAME]. Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty.

Heard they're posted over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.

missions.title: Need someone taken out
missions.briefing:
Got a crew that's been hitting Headhunter ships lately. Their leader's a real piece of work named [TARGETNAME]. We've tracked them to [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so we're looking for someone to put them down for good.

This group likes to fight, but shouldn't be a problem for someone like you.

Get over there and get it done.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Shot in the chaos
missions.briefing:
My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.

Security there's being run by [TARGETNAME] and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Wanted: [TARGETNAME]
missions.briefing:
Here's the deal, we just got word that a XenoThreat power player named [TARGETNAME] just came out of hiding and was spotted at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure [TARGETNAME|LAST] doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.

This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.

Stows out.

Security there's being run by [TARGETNAME] and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Wanted: [TARGETNAME]
missions.briefing:
Here's the deal, we just got word that a XenoThreat power player named [TARGETNAME] just came out of hiding and was spotted at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure [TARGETNAME|LAST] doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.

This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: XenoThreat Lieutenant needs some killing
missions.briefing:
Headhunters just rallied up a crew to go hit [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and wipe out the XenoThreat there, but I'm looking to add some extra insurance.

See there's this heavy hitter there named [TARGETNAME] who's up in the XenoThreat command structure and we want them taken out. Every other one you kill is gravy, but they're your prime target.

-Stows
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Bleeding Edge Tech / Turning the Tables / Upgrade Grab
missions.briefing:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

- or -

If you're looking to make some primo creds then we've got a job for you. Someone stole a piece of tech from one of our transporters and is trying to sell it back to us.

The nullbrain didn't even realize we were tracing their comms when they comm'd us up trying to extort us. Now all you have to do is go to [LOCATION|ADDRESS], grab the tech, and take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS]. We don't know what the situation is over there so maybe bring a weapon or two with you. Could be fine though.

-Bit Zeros

- or -

We need someone to head over [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and find a piece of tech for us. You don't need to know what the tech is/who it belongs to/why we need it, all you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and we'll get you paid. There could be people protecting it, but that's kind of your problem.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: All Things Come To An End
missions.briefing:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own.

Please head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and kill [TARGETNAME]. What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

missions.title: Deep space hit
missions.system: Pyro: Pyro IV, Pyro V, Terminus
missions.briefing:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TARGETNAME] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TARGETNAME|LAST] around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Drop a XenoThreat
missions.briefing:
Got a line on a XenoThreat that's been a pain in the ass. Not sure if you've heard the name, but [TARGETNAME] is a scumbag even by XenoThreat standards. Vicious, sadistic, and a prick to boot. We want someone to punch their number. You up for it?

Last word was that they were somewhere around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Head there and take 'em out. Pretty simple.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Kill the king
missions.system: Pyro: Pyro IV, Pyro V, Terminus
missions.briefing:
Looking for any hitters available for a quick gig. Over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS], they're getting hit by some geniuses led by [TARGETNAME]. We've tussled against [TARGETNAME|LAST] in the past so it's no surprise they haven't wised up.

We want you to head there and take them down. Kill whoever you like, but [TARGETNAME|LAST] should be your focus.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Need a CFP taken down
missions.system: Pyro: Pyro IV, Pyro V, Terminus
missions.briefing:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named [TARGETNAME]. Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty.

Heard they're posted over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Paid Target in CFP
missions.briefing:
Headhunters are launching an attack near [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. This ex-Marine asshole named [TARGETNAME] has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, [TARGETNAME|LAST] has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, [TARGETNAME|LAST] may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Plug a traitor
missions.briefing:
This shit saddens me. Not sure if you've ever crossed paths with [TARGETNAME] in your dealings with us. Thought they were a real good one. Been with the Headhunters for years, but something must have happened because they went running to CFP for protection. Sold out some of our brothers and sisters along the way.

All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to [LOCATION|ADDRESS], find [TARGETNAME|LAST], and kill them.

Doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just want the result.

Damn shame.

Stows out.

missions.title: Big Style LMG
missions.briefing: Warriors should feel strong, yes? What makes you feel more very strong than looking amazing? Wikelo will make your gun look like different gun. Bring me item on list and I give to you. Bye.

missions.title: Bounty Assignment: [TARGETNAME] (HRT)
missions.briefing:
Hey,

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name [TARGETNAME] has been located at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

Based on our intel, its highly unlikely that the target’s going to be sitting and waiting out in the open. You most likely will have to infiltrate the facility and draw them out.

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
missions.briefing:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
missions.briefing:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans.

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
missions.briefing:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation.

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
missions.briefing:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system.

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
missions.briefing:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
missions.briefing:
There is a group of outlaws at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system.

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves.

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Take Outlaws at [LOCATION] Offline
missions.briefing:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity.

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion.

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Updated Power Usage Data
missions.briefing:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
It would be helpful to have the most recent energy anomaly data so that we can compare it to what you delivered last time. Any difference between the two data sets could prove useful.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and retrieve the Energy Anomaly data and deliver it to [DESTINATION|ADDRESS].

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a ASD Secure Drive that you can collect at your home location.

missions.title: Bleeding Edge Tech / Turning the Tables / Upgrade Grab
missions.briefing:

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

- or -

If you're looking to make some primo creds then we've got a job for you. Someone stole a piece of tech from one of our transporters and is trying to sell it back to us.

The nullbrain didn't even realize we were tracing their comms when they comm'd us up trying to extort us. Now all you have to do is go to [LOCATION|ADDRESS], grab the tech, and take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS]. We don't know what the situation is over there so maybe bring a weapon or two with you. Could be fine though.

-Bit Zeros

- or -

We need someone to head over [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and find a piece of tech for us. You don't need to know what the tech is/who it belongs to/why we need it, all you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and we'll get you paid. There could be people protecting it, but that's kind of your problem.

missions.title: Bad at Goodbyes

These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS], we can really make it worth your while.

Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that we want.

missions.title: Getting To the Bottom of It
missions.briefing:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS]. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros

Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] for us.

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Our Version of The Truth
missions.briefing:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Snatch that blackbox at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Too Smart For Our Own Good
missions.briefing:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

-Bit Zeros

missions.briefing:

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.title: Bleeding Edge Tech / Turning the Tables / Upgrade Grab
missions.briefing:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

- or -

If you're looking to make some primo creds then we've got a job for you. Someone stole a piece of tech from one of our transporters and is trying to sell it back to us.

The nullbrain didn't even realize we were tracing their comms when they comm'd us up trying to extort us. Now all you have to do is go to [LOCATION|ADDRESS], grab the tech, and take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS]. We don't know what the situation is over there so maybe bring a weapon or two with you. Could be fine though.

-Bit Zeros

- or -

We need someone to head over [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and find a piece of tech for us. You don't need to know what the tech is/who it belongs to/why we need it, all you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and we'll get you paid. There could be people protecting it, but that's kind of your problem.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Getting Our Gear Back / Stash Retrieval / Cleaning Up a Mess
missions.briefing:
If you want something done right, you gotta do it yourself. That's what they say, right? Wish I had the time for that, but I have a business to run.

Some of our goods have been mislaid and I need a contractor to put this right for me. Got some info that the guys at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] ghosted one of my gang and got their hands on our gear. I need you to grab the stuff, deal with anyone at the location and take it to the drop-off at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] for me. Get it done and I'll sort out your payment.

-Twitch

- or -

Plan is to start expanding our operations in Nyx and step one is to control the supply line. If the other gangs in this system know what's good for them they'll stay out of our way.

Got word that one of our competitors is stashing some gear over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and I need you to grab it for me. When you're done, take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and don't be afraid to deal with anyone that gets in your way.

-Twitch

- or -

One of my crew was supposed to be picking up some goods at a dead drop just outside Levski, but they ended up coming back to me with their tail between their legs empty handed.

Anyway, long story short, turns out it all got a bit messy and some other gang ended up getting a hold of our gear and taking it to [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. We can't afford to let perfectly good merchandise slip away like that, so you're gonna head over there and get it back for us. Once you've done that, take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and I'll get you paid.

-Twitch

missions.title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Exclusive)
missions.briefing:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the exclusive mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
missions.briefing:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
missions.briefing:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Intercepted Supply Run
missions.briefing:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS]. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott

Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. Be safe out there,

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Special Recovery Operation
missions.briefing:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] in order to take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS].

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Stows out.

missions.briefing:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Out of an over-abundance of caution, it would be good to see if the security systems have picked up anything new since the last batch of data you delivered. That way we can make sure we’re up-to-date on what’s been happening down there.

Explore the Research wing and retrieve the Security data and deliver it to [DESTINATION|ADDRESS].

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a ASD Secure Drive that you can collect at your home location.

missions.title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: [SHIP]
missions.briefing:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] looking to be topped up with [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit

******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Crew Hasn’t Checked In

WORK BRIEF:

Thanks

missions.title: Bad at Goodbyes
missions.briefing:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS], we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Data Transfer
missions.briefing:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.

If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?

Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that we want.

All you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Getting To the Bottom of It
missions.briefing:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS]. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Legendary Info?
missions.briefing:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] for us.

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Our Version of The Truth
missions.briefing:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Snatch that blackbox at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

Apparently, this area is a bit of a hot zone. Probably why they staged the accident there. You should probably bring some backup so you don’t get ghosted before you can bring the blackbox to us at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Pick Up, Put Down
missions.briefing:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Too Smart For Our Own Good
missions.briefing:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Retake Platforms From Nine Tails
missions.briefing:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:

Your priority is to disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces.

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission.

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Hit on XenoThreat command
missions.briefing:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Hitting a CFP site
missions.briefing:
Need someone to sweep [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge.

Need it done fast and clean.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Need a hitter
missions.briefing:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
missions.briefing:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGETNAME]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Taking XenoThreat Turf
missions.briefing:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts.

We've also gotten word that [TARGETNAME] is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up.

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Taking down a XenoThreat Hideout
missions.briefing:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named [TARGETNAME]. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of [TARGETNAME|LAST] or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and [TARGETNAME|LAST] won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Taking out some XenoThreat trash
missions.briefing:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Turf War
missions.briefing:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: [LOCATION] has been greenlit
missions.briefing:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Bounty Assignment: [TARGETNAME] (HRT)
missions.briefing:
Hey,

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name [TARGETNAME] has been located at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

Based on our intel, its highly unlikely that the target’s going to be sitting and waiting out in the open. You most likely will have to infiltrate the facility and draw them out.

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Back up needed at outpost
missions.system: Pyro: Pyro IV, Pyro V, Terminus
missions.briefing:
Those XenoThreat punks launched an attack against [LOCATION|ADDRESS] so we're looking for people to go fend them off.

Get out there and waste every XenoThreat you see.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Death and cargo
missions.system: Pyro: Pyro IV, Pyro V, Terminus
missions.briefing:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back.

Once you got the cargo, take it over to [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Go on the warpath
missions.briefing:
Looking for some hitters to go drop some violence on some local dipshits who've been pulling jobs in the system against Headhunters. We tried reaching out to explain the error of their ways, but they shot our messenger, so now we go with option B.

You'll find them holed up near [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Go there and repaint the walls with their blood.

Have fun.

Stows out.

missions.title: Green light on [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
It's sad to say but we lost one of our outposts to XenoThreat. Appalling if you ask me, but that's why we're looking for someone who's got the time and ammunition to take it back.

If that's you, head over to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and take it back.

Stows out.

missions.briefing:
Here's the deal. Some of those mercs that CFP hired as security went and shot up some Headhunters that were just moving through the system. They weren't even doing anything, just flying.

Anyway, we tracked them back to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and want to dish out some payback. Grab your gear and be our weapon, we'll make it worth your while.

- Stows
