missions.title: Bad at Goodbyes
missions.briefing:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS], we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Data Transfer
missions.briefing:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.

If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?

Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that we want.

All you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Getting To the Bottom of It
missions.briefing:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS]. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Legendary Info?
missions.briefing:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] for us.

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Our Version of The Truth
missions.briefing:
I’m not gonna give you the whole backstory of what this person has done to us, but all you need to know is that some scumbag is trying to get a payout for a ship crash and the insurance company wants to see the blackbox recording to make sure everything is “above board”.

We’re not gonna let that happen though.

Snatch that blackbox at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and bring it to us instead so we can do some “creative editing” on the recording.

Apparently, this area is a bit of a hot zone. Probably why they staged the accident there. You should probably bring some backup so you don’t get ghosted before you can bring the blackbox to us at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Pick Up, Put Down
missions.briefing:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Too Smart For Our Own Good
missions.briefing:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

-Bit Zeros
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: A Swift Reprisal
missions.briefing:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: A little retaliation
missions.briefing:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Block XenoThreat Expansion
missions.briefing:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm [LOCATION|ADDRESS] next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it.

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely.

Think you can rise to the occasion?

-Stows
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Death and cargo
missions.briefing:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back.

Once you got the cargo, take it over to [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Driving CFP out
missions.briefing:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole [TARGETNAME] opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.

I need some hard workers to go hit [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and take out [TARGETNAME|LAST]. Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Hit XenoThreat at [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Hit a CFP Complex
missions.briefing:
Got a big one here. We need a team to head out to [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Word is CFP are dug in at three different clusters in the area. Our judge wants them all cleared out. Seems one of their mercs, a real mean skag named [TARGETNAME], is holed up at one of them. We want you to go there, clear them all out and take out [TARGETNAME|LAST].

Get yourself a nice little payday in the process.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Hit on XenoThreat command
missions.briefing:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Hitting a CFP site
missions.briefing:
Need someone to sweep [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge.

Need it done fast and clean.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Need a hitter
missions.briefing:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows
missions.risk_text: minimal danger FPS NOT ship action

missions.title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
missions.briefing:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TARGETNAME]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Taking XenoThreat Turf
missions.briefing:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts.

We've also gotten word that [TARGETNAME] is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up.

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Taking down a XenoThreat Hideout
missions.briefing:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named [TARGETNAME]. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of [TARGETNAME|LAST] or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and [TARGETNAME|LAST] won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Taking out some XenoThreat trash
missions.briefing:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Turf War
missions.briefing:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: [LOCATION] has been greenlit
missions.briefing:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
missions.briefing:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
missions.briefing:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans.

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott

missions.title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
missions.briefing:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

missions.title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
missions.briefing:

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

missions.title: Bleeding Edge Tech / Turning the Tables / Upgrade Grab
missions.briefing:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

- or -

If you're looking to make some primo creds then we've got a job for you. Someone stole a piece of tech from one of our transporters and is trying to sell it back to us.

The nullbrain didn't even realize we were tracing their comms when they comm'd us up trying to extort us. Now all you have to do is go to [LOCATION|ADDRESS], grab the tech, and take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS]. We don't know what the situation is over there so maybe bring a weapon or two with you. Could be fine though.

-Bit Zeros

- or -

We need someone to head over [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and find a piece of tech for us. You don't need to know what the tech is/who it belongs to/why we need it, all you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and we'll get you paid. There could be people protecting it, but that's kind of your problem.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Bad at Goodbyes
missions.briefing:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS].
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS], we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Data Transfer
missions.briefing:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.

If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?

Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that we want.

All you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.

missions.title: Getting To the Bottom of It
missions.briefing:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and take it to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS]. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS] for us.

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

missions.title: Too Smart For Our Own Good
missions.briefing:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION|TARGET|ADDRESS].

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

missions.title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
missions.briefing:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS] is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION|ADDRESS] and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott

missions.briefing:

There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

missions.title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Exclusive)
missions.briefing:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the exclusive mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TARGETNAME] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TARGETNAME|LAST] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Simple Hit
missions.briefing:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TARGETNAME] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and you should find [TARGETNAME|LAST] flying around.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Target at [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TARGETNAME] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that [TARGETNAME|LAST] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid.

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
missions.briefing:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TARGETNAME] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGETNAME|LAST] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Treat yourself to a fight
missions.briefing:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TARGETNAME] has been spotted flying around [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Wanna be a Headhunter?
missions.briefing:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

[TARGETNAME] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Wanted: [TARGETNAME]
missions.briefing:
We got a greenlight to finally take out [TARGETNAME]. They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all.

We've gotten word that [TARGETNAME|LAST] was spotted flying near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: [TARGETNAME] needs stomping
missions.briefing:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TARGETNAME] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it.

Last we heard they were spotted around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

missions.title: Crash some ships
missions.briefing:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and likely rearming for another attack.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

missions.briefing:

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor [SCRIPAMOUNT] Council Scrip for a job well done.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn [SCRIPAMOUNT] Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

missions.title: Retrieve Additional Smuggler Intel
missions.briefing:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.

The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we update our intel.

We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old QV Logistics station.

The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the encrypted data and use the decryption key to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.

Good luck. We’ll be in touch.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

missions.title: Deal with [TARGETNAME] and Support Forces
missions.briefing:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVALCODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. [TARGETNAME] and their crew were identified executing a raid on [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. If their MO holds true, [TARGETNAME|LAST] has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again.

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of [TARGETNAME|LAST] difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force [TARGETNAME|LAST] to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.

missions.briefing:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Movements

WORK BRIEF:
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and plug a small listening device into their server. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.briefing:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System

missions.title: Crash some ships
missions.briefing:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and likely rearming for another attack.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Ghost some XenoTrash
missions.briefing:

missions.title: Crash some ships
missions.briefing:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and likely rearming for another attack.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

missions.title: Ghost some XenoTrash
missions.briefing:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TARGETNAME] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TARGETNAME|LAST] was spotted flying around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight.

Stows out.

missions.title: Simple Hit
missions.briefing:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TARGETNAME] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and you should find [TARGETNAME|LAST] flying around.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Target at [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TARGETNAME] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that [TARGETNAME|LAST] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid.

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
missions.briefing:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TARGETNAME] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGETNAME|LAST] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Treat yourself to a fight
missions.briefing:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TARGETNAME] has been spotted flying around [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Wanna be a Headhunter?
missions.briefing:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

[TARGETNAME] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Wanted: [TARGETNAME]
missions.briefing:
We got a greenlight to finally take out [TARGETNAME]. They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all.

We've gotten word that [TARGETNAME|LAST] was spotted flying near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: [TARGETNAME] needs stomping
missions.briefing:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TARGETNAME] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it.

Last we heard they were spotted around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Crash some ships
missions.briefing:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and likely rearming for another attack.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Ghost some XenoTrash
missions.briefing:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TARGETNAME] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TARGETNAME|LAST] was spotted flying around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: without help, player and ship die

missions.title: Hit a CFP Ship
missions.briefing:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named [TARGETNAME|LAST] who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Kill Order
missions.briefing:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to [TARGETNAME], who's been driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Primo Target
missions.briefing:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TARGETNAME] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TARGETNAME|LAST] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

missions.title: Defend [LOCATION] From Mercs
missions.briefing:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact [LOCATION|ADDRESS] has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the [OBJECTS] and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a crew of your own to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any friendly ships that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor [SCRIPAMOUNT] Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.

missions.title: Guard [LOCATION] From Rivals
missions.briefing:
The maintenance and reliable function of [LOCATION|ADDRESS] is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting [OBJECTS] there.

Protecting the site, and any friendly ships, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some reliable backup along when you go and terminate these nullbrains.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn [SCRIPAMOUNT] Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and likely rearming for another attack.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Ghost some XenoTrash
missions.briefing:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TARGETNAME] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TARGETNAME|LAST] was spotted flying around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: without help, player and ship die

missions.title: Hit a CFP Ship
missions.briefing:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named [TARGETNAME|LAST] who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Kill Order
missions.briefing:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to [TARGETNAME], who's been driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Primo Target
missions.briefing:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TARGETNAME] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TARGETNAME|LAST] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player likely to die, ship too

missions.title: Simple Hit
missions.briefing:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TARGETNAME] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and you should find [TARGETNAME|LAST] flying around.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Target at [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [LOCATION|ADDRESS] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TARGETNAME] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that [TARGETNAME|LAST] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid.

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
missions.briefing:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TARGETNAME] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TARGETNAME|LAST] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Treat yourself to a fight
missions.briefing:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TARGETNAME] has been spotted flying around [LOCATION|ADDRESS].

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: Wanna be a Headhunter?
missions.briefing:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

[TARGETNAME] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around [LOCATION|ADDRESS], so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
missions.risk_text: ship could get damaged, could lose cargo

missions.title: Wanted: [TARGETNAME]
missions.briefing:
We got a greenlight to finally take out [TARGETNAME]. They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all.

We've gotten word that [TARGETNAME|LAST] was spotted flying near [LOCATION|ADDRESS] and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
missions.risk_text: player might die, ship could explode

missions.title: [TARGETNAME] needs stomping
missions.briefing:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TARGETNAME] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it.

Last we heard they were spotted around [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

The maintenance and reliable function of [LOCATION|ADDRESS] is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting [OBJECTS] there.

Protecting the site, and any friendly ships, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some reliable backup along when you go and terminate these nullbrains.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn [SCRIPAMOUNT] Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
missions.risk_text: without help, player and ship die

missions.title: Stop Rival Attack at [LOCATION]
missions.briefing:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the [OBJECTS] there.

I need you and whatever crew you can muster on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any friendly ships that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor [SCRIPAMOUNT] Council Scrip.

- Stows

missions.title: Deal with [TARGETNAME] and Support Forces
missions.briefing:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVALCODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. [TARGETNAME] and their crew were identified executing a raid on [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. If their MO holds true, [TARGETNAME|LAST] has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again.

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of [TARGETNAME|LAST] difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force [TARGETNAME|LAST] to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: High-Risk Bounty: [TARGETNAME]
missions.briefing:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = [APPROVALCODE]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. [TARGETNAME] was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at [LOCATION|ADDRESS]. We’re looking for a contractor ready and willing to execute this bounty before they disappear again.

Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that [TARGETNAME|LAST] will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out [TARGETNAME|LAST] to face you directly.

Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Defend [LOCATION] From Mercs
missions.briefing:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact [LOCATION|ADDRESS] has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the [OBJECTS] and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a crew of your own to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any friendly ships that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor [SCRIPAMOUNT] Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.
